title: Completion path for Manager-executed governance tasks
problem: TASK_COMPLETE requires a worker assignment, lease and MERGED merge-queue item. Governance tasks the Manager executes itself (TASK-0001..0003: PRs #273, #274, branch creation) could never reach COMPLETED, so the operational state reported finished work as held (JRN-0011).

options.summary: Add TASK_COMPLETE_MANAGER_EXECUTED: Manager-only, UNASSIGNED -> COMPLETED for never-assigned tasks, same VERIFIED COMMIT/CI/MAIN_VERIFICATION bar, COMMIT anchored to the merge SHA replaces the merge-queue item
Assign Manager work to a worker slot and drive the worker lifecycle (rejected: fabricates worker execution)

rationale: Keeps the completion chain honest without inventing worker activity. The evidence bar is not lowered: VERIFIED COMMIT (anchored to the merge SHA), CI and MAIN_VERIFICATION at MAIN_VERIFIED with PASS are all required, dependencies must be COMPLETED, and tasks ever assigned to a worker must use TASK_COMPLETE. The single added edge UNASSIGNED -> COMPLETED is only reachable through this command (TASK_COMPLETE still requires a MERGED merge-queue item).
